Raga: Bhimplasi
Tala: Teental
Vocal: Birai Mein Dhoom Machayo Kanha
A soulful Hindustani classical vocal rendition by Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan, featuring “Birai Mein Dhoom Machayo Kanha”. The performance highlights the melodic character of the raga and the artist’s expressive voice and mastery of Hindustani classical music.
